On Hold jobs with Source_Function settlement_recalculation_lease are execution locks. They are not pending business requests; released leases are Done and expired leases are recovered on next recalculation.
Manual and scheduled recalculations share the unique per-booking lease. Missing Technical_Key or incomplete snapshots fail closed and require reconciliation or retry.
Due Pending/Retry jobs are FIFO by Created_Time; Priority does not override FIFO.
Failed final writes retain Processing until lock-expiry recovery; no false Done is reported.
Historical timestamp fields are not rewritten. Recovery also checks CRM Modified_Time to avoid prematurely reclaiming legacy locks.
